work.author: GREGORIUS PP. XVI.
work.description: Brief CLXXXII communicates to the fourth Neapolitan society of priests for ecclesiastical conferences, for three years, the privileges of the three older societies; LF39824 → LF39828 across page number 271 LF39825; complete 14 August 1838 closing. Refined body and full surrounding frame read literally. Issuer evidence is GREGORIUS PP. XVI. at LF39789–39789; the source closing at LF39864–39867 reads: Datum Romae apud sanctam Mariam Maio- rem sub annulo piscatoris die decima quarta augusti millesimo octingentesimo trigesimo oc- tavo, pontificatus Nostri anno octavo. Exact source extent and surrounding boundaries were inspected as uncorrected OCR; no complete print-image collation or historical authentication is claimed.
